page_title: HAV 1-3 MAR | Le Havre v Marseille 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.

90+9' 1 - 3 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Amine Gouiri (Marseille) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:3.
90+8' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
90+7' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

90+5' What a save from Geronimo Rulli! Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
90+1' Yassine Kechta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre).
90+1' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Loic Nego is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Loic Nego (Le Havre) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
90' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

90' Geronimo Rulli was forced into action to thwart Issa Soumare (Le Havre). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luiz Felipe (Marseille) comes onto the pitch for Mason Greenwood.
87' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

85' 1 - 2 Luis Henrique sends a lovely ball into Mason Greenwood (Marseille). He latches on to it and shoots inside the left post from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:2.
85' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathieu Gorgelin, who smothers the ball.
84' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) meets a cross inside the box, but Geronimo Rulli wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
82' It is time for a substitution. Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is on for Andre Ayew.
82' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

81' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Marseille.

80' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Marseille.

78' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Quentin Merlin (Marseille) is replacing Ulisses Garcia.
75' Close! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
74' Le Havre will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
74' Looks like Loic Nego (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
73' A player from Le Havre commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Marseille.
72' Corner kick. Le Havre will have an opportunity.

72' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Geronimo Rulli is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Good work from Le Havre as they win a corner.
68' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Josue Casimir feeds Issa Soumare (Le Havre), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:1.
64' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

64' Marseille are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Marseille.
63' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) replaces Fode Ballo-Toure.
63' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
62' The game is interrupted.
62' Substitution. Luis Henrique (Marseille) on for Jonathan Rowe.
59' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' 0 - 1 Goal Amine Gouiri (Marseille)! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) was put through by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the left side of the net. 0:1.
56' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
52' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) for a tough tackle.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.

50' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
50' The resulting corner from Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
49' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Mason Greenwood (Marseille). The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
48' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sees a yellow card from Willy Delajod after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
47' Loic Nego (Le Havre) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Willy Delajod has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
44' Marseille are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
40' The game is interrupted now, Issa Soumare (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

38' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Mathieu Gorgelin was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
38' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

37' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.

35' A rebound sits up nicely for Valentin Rongier (Marseille) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the right post and out for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.

34' Marseille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
30' Marseille fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

30' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Mathieu Gorgelin makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the left side of the target. Marseille win a corner.
28' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball.

27' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

24' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
23' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner.
23' Marseille are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
19' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
17' A corner kick by Marseille is thwarted by the well prepared Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre).
16' Marseille are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Marseille have a corner.

14' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
12' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

10' Crossbar! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
8' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
6' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

5' This shall not pass! Josue Casimir (Le Havre) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Le Havre force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Marseille show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will officiate today.
